author: Inside Edition
description: Imagine what a game of hockey would look like if all the ice melted. Maybe something like this? Underwater hockey is taking root and teams will gather in Dubai for an international tournament. Players say they enjoy the competition, but some enjoy the physical benefits even more. Players do make physical contact and use shorter sticks, but this version isn't as rough as typical ice hockey. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Underwater Hockey Gaining Popularity Across The World
